title: GT Advance - Championship Racing
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 1100008209 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Racing. Position/lap notes read nonsense (21584) in a PC run, so left out. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text:
Position, lap counter, speed and the tachometer sit on the top screen.
This page lists what to watch for.
widgets.label: Race HUD

widgets.text:
A accelerate, B brake
R shift up / L shift down (manual)
Select: change view
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text:
Cars are tuned Japanese street and touring machines.
Winning races unlocks more cars and tuning parts.
widgets.label: Car classes

widgets.text:
Engine, tyres, suspension and weight parts raise power and grip.
Heavier power needs better tyres to stay planted.
widgets.label: Tuning

widgets.text:
Brake before the corner, not in it.
The AI is strong on straights: win on corner exits.
Keep the revs high in manual for faster launches.
widgets.label: Racing tips

widgets.text:
Championship: a series of circuits, points per finish.
Time Attack and quick race on unlocked courses.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text: Tight city courses, fast highway runs and technical mountain passes.
widgets.label: Course types

widgets.text:
Parts are earned by winning; equip them in the garage between races.
Check the power/weight figures after each change.
widgets.label: Parts

widgets.text:
Cars and tuning parts unlocked by winning championships.
The car list grows with each title won.
widgets.label: Collectables

widgets.text:
Win every championship class to unlock the full garage.
First-place finishes give the most points.
widgets.label: Goal
